title: asset_needs[]: assets a plan asks for (upscaled logo, icon, cut-out, background, B-roll)
description: Optional `asset_needs` array of edit-decisions.json and motion-script.json (3.0 T2.3; used by Phase 5 `reel assets-plan`). Each need is anchored to the words spoken when it appears. A standalone file is {"asset_needs": [...]}. Check with `reel validate <file>`.

schema_version.description: the version of this schema the file follows

time.description: seconds (12.5), milliseconds as an integer in edit-decisions.json, or a clock: 00:00:12.500 / 01:02.5

id.description: e.g. N01; unique in the file

purpose.description: what the asset is for, in one line
